title: Congressman Cuellar, Ambassador Flores Bermúdez Address Human Smuggling Networks Following Laredo Rail Yard Deaths | U.S. Congressman Henry Cuellar, Ph.D.
text:
Congressman Cuellar, Ambassador Flores Bermúdez Address Human Smuggling Networks Following Laredo Rail Yard DeathsEl congresista Cuellar y el embajador Flores Bermúdez abordan las redes de tráfico de personas tras las muertes en el patio ferroviario de Laredo
Washington, DC | Matt Landini, Communications Director, matt@mail.house.gov,
May 13, 2026
U.S. Congressman Henry Cuellar, Ph.D. (TX-28) met today with Ambassador Roberto Flores Bermúdez of Honduras to discuss regional issues affecting both the United States and Central America, including the ongoing investigation into the deaths of Mexican and Honduran nationals found inside a shipping container at a Union Pacific rail yard in Laredo. |
